scope: Frozen N06-B06 v1 whole-object semantic and identity review only; no source/producer/consumer/admission/native/full-N06/full-BIZQ acceptance.
summaryFindings: All 18 Details.scenarioApplication values reuse meta-authoring text (“The added handler facts...”) instead of explaining how the scenario’s own coverage, pass, precedence and terminal/partial result select the chain behavior. This fails the required mechanism → scenario application narrative.

Wrong-option text duplicates make distinct answers indistinguishable for i004, i006–i011, i013–i018. The largest cases have three or four identical wrong choices; IDs alone do not make them different plausible alternatives.

Many errorCorrection fields are stale from the previous source objects (exact item IDs in the per-item findings), including research importer/decoder, access revocation, invoice validation, provider streams, queues, reviewers, parsers, fees, notification channels, repositories and formatters. These are not merely repetitive; they explain different cases and can misteach the current case.

i014 changes from terminal Chain behavior to partial fulfillment that passes only the unfilled remainder; the answer can fit an ordered chain, but the mechanism and feedback must explain continued processing and preserved request identity.
identityFinding: Preserve the existing question IDs because both full before and current objects remain Chain-of-Responsibility/ordered-handler exercises and the accepted keyed idea is the same ordered-handler decision. The current proposal retains the old correct option ID owner_preserves_contract; for i014, explicitly assess the partial-accept/remainder continuation meaning when correcting its explanation, and mint a fresh option ID if its answer semantics are changed beyond the original generic clear-stop meaning.
criteria: Existing BIZQ-01 §§4.1, 4.3 and 4.4: one answer grounded in visible facts; realistic alternatives with distinct decision content; causal Reason/Details and feedback tied to current option IDs. No numeric similarity threshold, option-count quota or new product rule is applied.
